title: Dish session v4.B proposed wire contract
description: GM-07.B forward-only proposal. It extends GM-07.A with room preferences, join preview, explicit concurrency guards, history projections and immutable aggregate Top 3 results. Transport is the opt-in dish_session_v4 RPC. It is not a deployed runtime contract.

submissionStatus.description: Current-round complete ACK status only; does not imply that the caller is waiting.

topDishes.description: Semantic checks require the persisted winner to have the maximum score among eligible dishes; equal scores share a dense rank, including a tie for rank 1.
